title: Mantsu suite manifest, version 1
description: The landscape a Mantsu frontend renders its navigation rail from. Normative document: docs/suite-manifest.md. This schema is for PRODUCER validation: it sets additionalProperties false so a backend emitting an undefined field fails its own tests. Consumers must not validate with it, because ignoring unknown fields is what lets the contract grow additively.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of this contract. Incremented only by a removal, a rename, a narrowing, or a change of meaning.

self.description: The app that served this response. Always also present in apps[].

source.description: core: the landscape came from Core, or this is Core. fallback: Core was never reached, so apps contains only self.

stale.description: True when a relay is serving its last good copy because Core is unreachable right now. Absent means fresh. Never true together with source fallback: there is nothing cached to be stale.

suite.description: Suite-wide links. Present exactly when core is in apps[], because both targets live in Core.

apps.description: The landscape, ordered by order ascending. Never empty: self is always in it.

allOf.$comment: source fallback means Core was never reached, so there can be no Core to link to and no second app to list.

appKey.description: A lowercase slug identifying an app, equal to the appKey Core publishes in the role catalogue. OPEN since NAV-19: adding an app is a configuration change, not a schema change. Narrow on purpose, because this value reaches URLs, data- attributes and a role-catalogue lookup.

name.description: Display name as configured. Not translated: these are product names.

icon.description: An icon key the consumer maps to a component, never markup. An unknown key renders a generic glyph rather than failing.

url.description: Public origin in this environment, without a trailing slash.

order.description: Rail order, ascending. Configured rather than derived. Ties break on key.

nav.description: The app's own rail items. Phase 2; absent in phase 1.

key.description: Stable per app, unique within that app's nav.

label.description: Both languages, always: the rail has no fallback language.

path.description: Path within that app, appended to the app's url.

group.description: configuration renders under the inert Configuration subtitle; null is an ordinary sub-item. Explicit rather than optional, so a producer that forgets it fails instead of silently moving an item out of Configuration.
